message: Requirement R-a (R-a title) is implemented only by whole-file anchors, so its coverage says a test touches those files, not the code behind the claim.
suggestion: Link the functions, methods or types that implement the requirement with implements (and covered_by to their tests); keep the file anchor only for genuinely module-level behavior.
